summary:
Implementation plan to fix multi-card Agent focus rendering in Nano LOD canvas mode.

Key Changes:
1. Update NanoLodCanvas props to pass `agentTargetCardIds` (Set/Array of card IDs) and `agentFocusMap` / `agentQuickInput` state.
2. In NanoLodCanvas renderer, draw solid purple focus borders (`#9333ea`) for all focused cards in `agentTargetCardIds` or `agentFocusMap`.
3. Render canvas-native Agent status badge and cursor/speak indicators on all focused cards in Nano LOD mode.
4. Ensure full consistency between Full LOD (DOM) and Nano LOD (Canvas) Agent focus states.
